snapshot.title: SQLite index
snapshot.description:
A gitignored SQLite index (via `modernc.org/sqlite`) for fast queries and graph rendering, always rebuildable from the `.underdraw/` files. Step 2 uses an in-memory index instead; add this when the graph view or larger repos need it, behind the same interface.

Requirements.md: Architecture → Storage. Lives under `.underdraw/run/` (already gitignored).
